welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to FinanceFlow!
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of the main features. You can skip at any time.

dashboard.title: 📊 Dashboard
dashboard.description: Here you have an overview of your finances — income, expenses, balance and current month charts.

transactions.title: 💸 Transactions
transactions.description: Record all your income and expenses. You can filter, search and attach receipts.

categories.title: 🏷️ Categories
categories.description: Organise transactions by category. Create custom categories with icon and colour.

budgets.title: 🎯 Budgets
budgets.description: Set spending limits by category and receive alerts when you're approaching the limit.
